### Patristic & Magisterial Sources

- **Augustine:** *Confessions* 1.1.1 (restless heart); *City of God* XIV.13 (pride); *incurvatus in se*
- **Aquinas:** *ST* I-II q.26 a.4 (*amor est velle alicui bonum*); II-II q.26 (Ordo Amoris); II-II q.47-56 (Prudence); II-II q.62 (Restitution); II-II q.81 (Religion under Justice); II-II q.99 (Sacrilege)
- **Irenaeus:** *Against Heresies* 4.20.7 (glory of God = man fully alive)

- **John Paul II:** *Dives in Misericordia*; *Evangelium Vitae*; *Christifideles Laici*; Divine Mercy Sunday
- **Trent:** Session 22 ch.1 (priesthood and sacrifice)
